# rviz_sonar_image

- **Layer**: ui
- **Packages**: `rviz_sonar_image`
- **Language**: C++
- **Governance**: No `.agents/README.md` — consider creating one

## Key Dependencies
- marine_acoustic_msgs, pluginlib, rclcpp, rviz_common

## Description
RViz plugin for displaying sonar imagery. Renders acoustic sonar data (side-scan, multibeam) as visual overlays in RViz.
